content: PASSWORD RESET: Go to company IT portal. Click Forgot Password. Enter your employee email. Check inbox for reset link. Follow instructions. Password must be 8+ characters with uppercase, number and symbol. Password expires every 90 days. Cannot reuse last 5 passwords.

PASSWORD LOCKED ACCOUNT: Account locks after 5 failed attempts. Wait 30 minutes for automatic unlock. Or contact IT support for immediate unlock. Email swapniljoshi1729@gmail.com with employee ID and manager name for urgent unlocks.

PASSWORD COMPLEXITY REQUIREMENTS: Minimum 8 characters. At least one uppercase letter. At least one lowercase letter. At least one number. At least one special symbol. Cannot contain your name or employee ID. Must be changed every 90 days.

JIRA TICKET CREATION: Go to jira.company.com. Click Create button. Select project. Choose issue type. Add title and description. Assign priority. Click Submit. You will receive email confirmation with ticket ID.

JIRA ACCESS REQUEST: Submit IT request form at itportal.company.com. Select Jira Access Request. Enter your manager email for approval. IT team processes within 2 business days. You will receive login credentials via email.
JIRA TICKET STATUS: Log into jira.company.com. Click on My Issues. Filter by status Open In Progress or Closed. Click on ticket ID for full details. Add comments to update the IT team.

SALESFORCE ACCESS REQUEST: Submit IT request form. Manager approval required. IT team processes within 2 business days. Confirmation email sent. Login with company SSO credentials. Contact swapniljoshi1729@gmail.com if access not granted within 3 days.

SALESFORCE LOGIN ISSUES: Clear browser cache and cookies. Try incognito window. Ensure using company SSO login not personal email. Reset SSO password if needed. Contact IT if issue persists after above steps.

SALESFORCE PERMISSION ISSUES: Contact your manager to verify your role permissions. Manager submits permission change request via IT portal. IT team updates profile within 1 business day. Log out and log back in after update.
VPN SETUP: Download Cisco AnyConnect from company portal. Enter server address vpn.company.com. Use employee ID and password. Contact IT if connection fails. VPN required for all remote work.

VPN CONNECTION ISSUES: Check internet connection first. Disconnect and reconnect VPN. Clear VPN cache by uninstalling and reinstalling Cisco AnyConnect. Verify vpn.company.com server address. Contact IT support if issue persists after reinstall.

VPN SLOW PERFORMANCE: Disconnect and reconnect to refresh connection. Try connecting to different VPN server region if available. Close bandwidth-heavy applications. Contact IT if slowness persists more than 30 minutes.

EMAIL ACCESS ISSUES: Verify you are using company email credentials. Clear browser cache. Try different browser. Check if Outlook desktop app needs update. Contact IT if unable to access after above steps.
EMAIL QUOTA FULL: Delete emails from Sent Items and Deleted Items folders. Empty Deleted Items folder. Archive old emails to local folders. Contact IT to request mailbox size increase if needed.

LAPTOP HARDWARE ISSUES: Restart laptop first for minor issues. For screen issues check display cable connection. For keyboard issues try external keyboard. For battery issues contact IT for replacement. For major hardware failure submit urgent ticket immediately.

PRINTER SETUP: Go to Settings. Select Printers and Scanners. Click Add Printer. Select your office printer from list. Install drivers if prompted. Print test page to verify. Contact IT if printer not visible in list.

NEW SOFTWARE INSTALLATION REQUEST: Submit software request via IT portal. Include software name version and business justification. Manager approval required. IT evaluates security and licensing. Installation scheduled within 5 business days after approval.

ESCALATION: If issue cannot be resolved through standard steps contact IT support team immediately. Email swapniljoshi1729@gmail.com. Phone +91 9371615190. Available Monday-Friday 9AM-6PM IST. For urgent issues outside hours email with URGENT in subject line.
